testable.title: Are Three Matrices All You Need To Beat the Market? Observable Matrix Dynamics for Portfolio Optimization
testable.impl_sketch: 월말 trailing 21d rv → 횡단면 10분위 → rolling 36M P^V 추정 → π^V_i = P^V[decile_i, {1,2}] (하위 2분위 도달확률) → 상위 25종 EW 월간 리밸 15bps
cautions: 5bps 기준 L-only in-sample 열세 → 15bps 마진 thin. KR cap-tier 분해 병행.

non_testable.title: Fund Competition under Conflicting ESG Rating Methodologies
non_testable.reason: Pure theory (fund fee/portfolio choice under heterogeneous ESG preferences). 종목선택 신호 없음.

non_testable.title: Liquidity Premium and Investment Horizons
non_testable.reason: Core novel signal = Kyle's λ from signed order flow (requires TAQ tick-by-tick order flow data). RAWDATA has Vol(daily volume level) but NOT signed order flow directionality. Amihud-style ratio (secondary finding) is already in Factor DB. batch_434: 논문이 기술한 primary signal 충실 구현 불가.

non_testable.title: The Fundamental Structure of Risk: From Characteristics to Covariance
non_testable.reason: CD-DFM: characteristic-driven covariance estimator. Alpha signal 아님 — risk-research agent용 공분산 추정 모델. tier-2 재확인: 알파 claim 0건, Stein loss 최적화, RavenPack 뉴스 KR 불가. 판정 불변.

non_testable.title: AlphaZeroBeta: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Market-Neutral Portfolios
non_testable.reason: CNN-GRU+PPO 인덱스 수준 market-neutral 포트폴리오 optimizer. 횡단면 종목선택 팩터 신호 없음 — optimizer-research용.

non_testable.title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
non_testable.reason: KR 재무 뉴스 코퍼스 미보유 + Llama-3-8B GRPO training 인프라(A6000 GPU) 부재. tier-2 재검 확정.
